# Runbook Source Files Demo

Scripts start in the session's directory, not in the runbook's folder. `$RUNBOOK_SOURCE_FILES` is the absolute path of the runbook's folder, so a script can read the files that ship with the runbook, such as a helper library it shares with other scripts.

<Command
  id="greet"
  title="Source a shared helper"
  path="scripts/greet.sh"
/>
